def test_fizz_buzz():
    # Edge cases: empty/very small ranges
    assert fizz_buzz(0) == 0
    assert fizz_buzz(1) == 0
    assert fizz_buzz(-5) == 0

    # Small ranges with no 7s in collected digits
    assert fizz_buzz(12) == 0   # ns = [0, 11] -> "011"
    assert fizz_buzz(14) == 0   # ns = [0, 11, 13] -> "01113"
    assert fizz_buzz(50) == 0   # ns = [0,11,13,22,26,33,39,44] -> no '7'

    # Known values containing 7s
    assert fizz_buzz(78) == 2   # ...66, 77 -> two 7s from "77"
    assert fizz_buzz(79) == 3   # adds 78 -> one more '7'
    assert fizz_buzz(100) == 2  # includes 77 but not 78
    assert fizz_buzz(117) == 3  # includes 77 and 78

    # Result must be a non-negative int
    result = fizz_buzz(1000)
    assert isinstance(result, int)
    assert result >= 0

    # Consistency: increasing n can never decrease the count
    assert fizz_buzz(200) >= fizz_buzz(100)
    assert fizz_buzz(300) >= fizz_buzz(200)

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_fizz_buzz()
